# Nova Vision AI

> Nova Vision AI is a smart visual assistant that identifies food, plants, and everyday objects from your camera and delivers instant nutrition, safety, and care insights.

Nova Vision AI combines multimodal AI with an Apple-inspired interface. Sign in to scan images, chat with the AI, plan meals, and manage a private library of scans.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview and entry point to Nova Vision AI.
- [Sign in](/auth): Create an account or sign in with email or Google.
